messages:
arjun: heads-up: I enabled `segment_cache_affinity` in staging to test affinity-driven cache and noticed ~0.15% of preview traffic was routed to the low-cost pool. unexpected.

claire: saw the blip in the routing dashboard at ~14:12. paste the flag you rolled?

arjun: minimal change: scope=segment, affinity=on, rollout.pct=20.

ben: likely ordering interaction: we transform route_key for affinity then evaluate tier matchers. if transform runs before tier overrides, mutated keys can trigger cheaper matchers. iirc there's an old note about "transform-first" behavior. opened OPS-2142.

arjun: telemetry gap: rollout events only show final route. we need a tiny eval trace and hashed_segment id to repro without exposing customer ids.

claire: proposal: add enum-coded trace steps to telemetry proto (A1=seg-resolve,A2=affinity-transform,A3=tier-eval). keep traces tiny and sampled. add flag field `telemetry_level` (basic|trace|off). default basic.

ben: console UX: preview should call a dryrun endpoint with pseudo-request to compute expected route distribution and show a small "ordering impact" note. POST /v1/config/dryrun -> {decision, trace:["A2","A3"], est_delta}.

arjun: privacy: dryrun must never log raw tenant ids. telemetry for dryrun should include only flag id + sample_hash.

sre-bot: [14:30] Autoscaler: no scale events for latency-pool.

claire: ops safety: add rollout gate: if dryrun predicts >0.1% of rollout hitting non-latency pools for flags tagged `latency_sensitive=true`, block bump and require approver override in console.

ben: implementation plan: 1) proto enum + telemetry_level (ben). 2) dryrun/routing-sim (claire). 3) console preview + blocking UI (arjun). 4) short-term revert staging flag.

arjun: reverting now and logging in the retro. thanks. :thumbsup:

ui-bot: [14:36] Mockup posted to #product-ui: https://redwood.internal/mockups/dryrun-impact (shows est delta and approver flow).

sre-bot: [14:40] Flag revert: `segment_cache_affinity` rollout.pct=0 by arjun.

claire: follow-up: add `docs/config-eval/orderings.md` with canonical evaluation order and examples so flag authors understand transform vs tier interactions.

ben: also: keep trace enums on wire (compact) and map to text in console to keep telemetry small.

arjun: logged to rollout-retro. thanks everyone.
